newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Novosibirsk to decide by Sept on Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Novosibirsk to decide by Sept on Eurobond.

text.p: Russia's Novosibirsk region will decide by September 1 if it will issue a Eurobond, a regional official said on Monday.
"It is necessary to understand which volume of borrowing we shall be able to service," Deputy Securities Department Head Sergei Tsyvtsin told Reuters.
"We are to decide by September 1 on whether the Novosibirsk region will issue a Eurobond or not."
Though a draft government regulation on regional Eurobond issues says regions, like Novosibirsk, receiving money from the federal budget cannot issue Eurobonds, exceptions have been made.
Perm region, which received nine trillion roubles ($1.6 billion) in federal funding in the first half of 1997, has recently mandated Morgan Stanley to lead-manage its debut Eurobond.
Fifteen regions, including the City of Moscow, are planning Eurobond issues. City of Moscow is planning its second Eurobond issue in the autumn.
